external_entities.name: sensor node
external_entities.description: A deployed sensor node installed at a customer site that publishes readings and polls for firmware updates.
external_entities.source_excerpt: We have a few thousand sensor nodes installed on customer sites.
external_entities.notes: The nodes are outside our physical control. The text says: "I do not know whether the nodes check a signature on the image before installing it."

external_entities.name: field technician
external_entities.description: A technician who services sensor nodes over a local serial console.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Field technicians service nodes over a local serial console.
external_entities.notes: The text does not state what authentication the console has, if any.

external_entities.name: fleet operator
external_entities.description: An operator who views telemetry dashboards from the corporate network.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our own fleet operators look at dashboards over BigQuery from the corporate network, signed in with company SSO.

processes.name: device gateway
processes.description: An MQTT broker that accepts sensor readings and forwards them to Pub/Sub.
processes.source_excerpt: Each node publishes readings over MQTT to the device gateway, which is an MQTT broker we run on GKE
processes.notes: The broker uses a pre-shared key per fleet, not per device. Nobody has rotated the key since deployment.

processes.name: telemetry normalizer
processes.description: A Python consumer that picks up readings from Pub/Sub and writes them into the telemetry lake.
processes.source_excerpt: the telemetry normalizer, a Python consumer in our analytics network

data_stores.name: device registry
data_stores.description: A Firestore registry used to check device keys and identify the customer associated with a node.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The gateway looks up the device in a device registry (Firestore) to check the key and to find out which customer the node belongs to.

data_stores.name: Pub/Sub
data_stores.description: A messaging service onto which accepted readings are forwarded and from which the telemetry normalizer consumes them.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Readings the gateway accepts are forwarded onto Pub/Sub and picked up by the telemetry normalizer

data_stores.name: telemetry lake
data_stores.description: A BigQuery data store containing telemetry, site addresses, and occupancy patterns.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The lake has site addresses and occupancy patterns in it, so it is customer data.

data_stores.name: Cloud Storage bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket from which sensor nodes poll for firmware images.
data_stores.source_excerpt: nodes poll a Cloud Storage bucket for a new image and install what they find.
